title: The passive with ser: what was approved, sold and elected

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive with *ser* + past participle from B1 Unit 18 (*la ley fue aprobada*). The participle agrees with the subject. It is the natural way to tell what the liberal governments did: laws were approved, lands were sold, a president was elected.

sections.title: ser + participle
rows: La Ley Lerdo fue aprobada en 1856.

items.spanish: La Ley Lerdo fue aprobada en 1856.
items.english: The Lerdo Law was approved in 1856.

items.spanish: Las tierras de la Iglesia tenían que ser vendidas.
items.english: The lands of the Church had to be sold.

sections.content: The participle agrees with the subject: *la ley fue aprobada*, *las tierras fueron vendidas*. After a modal or *tener que* the passive uses *ser* in the infinitive: *tenían que ser vendidas*. The doer, if named, comes after *por*.
